description: Hand-labeled golden dataset for the customer support email classifier. All labels human-verified, no LLM-generated ground truth.

cases.input_email: Hi, I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Can you refund the duplicate charge?
cases.expected_summary: The customer was double-charged for their subscription and wants a refund.
cases.notes: Clear billing intent, single issue.

cases.input_email: My invoice #4482 shows a $50 fee I don't recognize. What is this for?
cases.expected_summary: The customer wants an explanation of an unrecognized fee on their invoice.
cases.notes: Clear billing, specific invoice reference.

cases.input_email: can you cancel my plan and give me a prorated refund for the rest of the month
cases.expected_summary: The customer wants to cancel their plan and receive a prorated refund.
cases.notes: Lowercase, no punctuation, still clear.

cases.input_email: I upgraded to the Pro plan yesterday but I'm still being billed at the old rate. Please fix.
cases.expected_summary: The customer upgraded plans but is still being billed the old rate and wants it corrected.
cases.notes: Billing issue tied to a plan change.

cases.input_email: Do you offer annual billing discounts? Comparing pricing before I commit.
cases.expected_summary: The customer is asking about annual billing discounts before committing to a plan.
cases.notes: Pre-sales but explicitly about pricing -> billing, not general.

cases.input_email: The export to CSV button throws a 500 error every time I click it on the dashboard.
cases.expected_summary: The customer's CSV export is failing with a 500 error on the dashboard.
cases.notes: Clear bug report.

cases.input_email: Our webhook integration stopped receiving events after your last deploy.
cases.expected_summary: The customer's webhook integration stopped receiving events after a recent deploy.
cases.notes: Clear technical/integration issue.

cases.input_email: app keeps crashing when i try to upload a file bigger than 10mb
cases.expected_summary: The app crashes when the customer uploads files larger than 10MB.
cases.notes: Typo-free but casual, still technical.

cases.input_email: Getting 'undefined is not a function' errors in the console after updating to v3.2 of your SDK.
cases.expected_summary: The customer is hitting a JavaScript error after updating to SDK version 3.2.
cases.notes: Developer-facing technical bug, mentions version number.

cases.input_email: teh api is retuning wierd dtaa somtimes for large requests, not consistant
cases.expected_summary: The customer reports the API inconsistently returns unexpected data for large requests.
cases.notes: Heavy typos, tests robustness of classification and summary quality.

cases.input_email: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. Can you help?
cases.expected_summary: The customer cannot reset their password because the reset email never arrives.
cases.notes: Clear account access issue.

cases.input_email: Need to change the email address linked to my account before I lose access to my old inbox.
cases.expected_summary: The customer wants to update the email address linked to their account.
cases.notes: Account settings change.

cases.input_email: my account got locked after too many login attempts, can you unlock it
cases.expected_summary: The customer's account was locked after repeated failed login attempts and needs to be unlocked.
cases.notes: Common account lockout scenario.

cases.input_email: I want to add my colleague as a second admin on our workspace.
cases.expected_summary: The customer wants to add a colleague as a second admin on their workspace.
cases.notes: Account/permissions management, not billing despite being 'workspace' related.

cases.input_email: two factor auth isnt sending codes to my phone anymore
cases.expected_summary: The customer's two-factor authentication codes are no longer being sent to their phone.
cases.notes: Could be mistaken for technical; it's account access.

cases.input_email: Just wanted to say your support team was amazing yesterday, thank you!
cases.expected_summary: The customer is thanking the support team for excellent help.
cases.notes: Pure feedback, no action needed.

cases.input_email: Do you have a public roadmap I can follow to see upcoming features?
cases.expected_summary: The customer is asking whether a public product roadmap exists.
cases.notes: General product question.

cases.input_email: hey
cases.expected_summary: The customer sent a message with no discernible request.
cases.notes: Extremely short, no content. Tests handling of near-empty input.

cases.input_email: Not really a complaint, just curious if you guys are hiring engineers right now.
cases.expected_summary: The customer is asking whether the company is currently hiring engineers.
cases.notes: Off-topic but should not be forced into another bucket.

cases.input_email: Interested in an enterprise demo, who do I talk to?
cases.expected_summary: The customer wants to be connected with someone for an enterprise demo.
cases.notes: Sales inquiry, tests whether model wrongly routes to billing.

cases.input_email: Great, another update that broke my invoice PDF export. Love this.
cases.expected_summary: The customer's invoice PDF export broke after a recent update.
cases.notes: Sarcastic tone; mentions invoice but the actual issue is a broken export feature (technical, not billing).

cases.input_email: cant log in AND my card was charged twice, please help asap!!
cases.expected_summary: The customer cannot log in and was also double-charged, and needs urgent help.
cases.notes: Two valid categories (account + billing) in one email; ground truth picks account as the primary blocker.

cases.input_email: Mon compte a ete bloque apres la mise a jour, je ne peux plus me connecter.
cases.expected_summary: The customer's account was locked after an update and they can no longer log in.
cases.notes: Mixed language / non-English input tests robustness.

cases.expected_summary: The customer sent a message with no interpretable content.
cases.notes: Degenerate input, single character.

cases.input_email: billing page wont load, just a blank screen, is this a bug on your end or is my account suspended?
cases.expected_summary: The customer's billing page shows a blank screen and they are unsure if it's a bug or a suspension.
cases.notes: Mentions billing and account but the reported symptom is a page failing to load -> technical.

cases.input_email: u guys suck my refund still isnt here its been 3 weeks this is ridiculous
cases.expected_summary: The customer is frustrated that a refund has not arrived after three weeks.
cases.notes: Hostile tone should not affect classification; tests summary neutrality.

cases.input_email: idk who to email but nothing on this site works right now, everything is broken
cases.expected_summary: The customer reports that the entire site appears to be broken.
cases.notes: Vague scope, no specifics, tests over-generalization in summary.

cases.input_email: Can I get a discount if I refer 3 friends and also why does the app log me out on my iPad specifically?
cases.expected_summary: The customer asks about a referral discount and reports being logged out specifically on their iPad.
cases.notes: Two intents (billing + account); ground truth prioritizes the account/session bug as primary.

cases.input_email: asdkjfh
cases.expected_summary: The customer sent an unintelligible message.
cases.notes: Gibberish input, tests graceful fallback to general.

cases.input_email: This is the third time I'm emailing about the same login bug you people never fix anything
cases.expected_summary: The customer is repeatedly reporting an unresolved login bug.
cases.notes: Login-related but framed as a recurring bug rather than a one-off account lockout -> technical, not account.
